title: Keynote: What is a Component (and Why)? - Luke Wagner, Distinguished Engineer, Fastly
summary: Luke Wagner of Fastly explains what a WebAssembly component is, how it relates to familiar concepts, and what the Component Model enables. It emphasizes security, composability and modularity.
why: HN recommends it as the best starting point for understanding the Wasm Component Model and WASI direction, straight from its designer.

quote.text: I thought this keynote presentation[0] by Luke Wagner at Wasmcon was great and covered it very well.
